name: fix-recipe-save
title: Fix recipe save action
description: Normalize the recipe modal payload so the existing upsert flow receives servingVariants and the save action completes.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: The modal emits variants while the shared Apollo hook, GraphQL input, resolver, and Mongoose model use servingVariants. RecipeList now normalizes the payload at the immediate caller boundary before add/update.
